requirements.summary: Every retiring instruction names the right destination register and writes the value the instruction word and the latest register values give.
A load or store makes exactly one bus transfer, with the address, lanes and data of the instruction; no other instruction makes one.
A register read returns the value of the latest retired write to that register, and x0 reads as zero.
The first retirement is at pc 0, each retirement is at the pc its predecessor leads to, and nothing retires after EBREAK.
Every instruction group and the pipeline situations of the checks are reachable; a core held in reset reaches none.
Each functional mutant of the core gives a counterexample at the planned assertion; the two performance-only mutants pass.
